title: BoundPanelRequest
description: Body of POST /api/panels/bound (HEL-364) — composes source (create-or-reuse) → pipeline+steps → synchronous run → panel create+bind in one call. Exactly one of `source` (inline columns+rows) or `sourceDataSourceId` (an existing, caller-owned DataSource) must be present; both or neither is rejected with 400 before any read or write. `panel.type` must be a data-bindable kind (metric/chart/table/collection/timeline) — the server injects the freshly created pipeline output `dataTypeId` (and `fieldMapping`, if given) into `panel.config` before creating the panel.

fieldMapping.description: Merged into panel.config.fieldMapping alongside the server-injected dataTypeId. Slot keys are panel-type-specific — see bind_panel's documented per-type shapes.

BoundSourceSpec.description: Inline static source — the backend auto-creates a `static` DataSource from this payload (CSV/URL inline sources are out of scope for this compound op). `rows` is positional array-of-arrays, one value per `columns` entry in order — matching StaticDataSourceRequest.rows, not a row-object shape.

name.description: Optional — defaults server-side to '<outputDataTypeName> pipeline' when absent.

items.description: Same shape POST /api/pipelines/:id/steps accepts (see add_pipeline_step for the full per-type config catalogue).

BoundPanelSpec.description: Mirrors CreatePanelRequest minus dashboardId (carried at the request's top level) and minus a binding (the server injects dataTypeId/fieldMapping once the pipeline's output DataType exists).
